gate2_width.note: identical to the reference; every overflow line is one prettier also overflows

gate4_agreement.note: full agreement. gate 4 for XML measures tag layout plus source-preserved content whitespace: the reference does not re-indent content, and normalisation.xml and whitespace.xml both probe that it does not.

fill.note: fill is used, not requested: the doctype external ID packs at 80 and breaks at 40, and the PUBLIC keyword must be a fill item rather than a fixed prefix

excluded.reason: prettier rewrites an empty element pair to a self-closing tag, replacing two named nodes (STag, ETag) with one (EmptyElemTag); gate 3 rejects it and no sanctioned token policy deletes a tag

stage_d.escalation: fixed by the builder, re-review required
stage_d.blocking_finding: XMLDecl hard-coded the double quote and the `yes` spelling, so standalone='no' and single-quoted declaration values refused in both runtimes while prettier formats them. Package bugs, not design limits.
claims_upheld: content indentation is source-preserved by the reference, and the corpus does probe it
wrapping only content in indent is correct, verified at width 12 and depth six against prettier
fill with a * selector consumes exactly the ExternalID children and swallows nothing
